original.statement: Upgrade step: update Provider manifests to v2 provider package versions, which support both cluster-scoped and namespaced managed resources; existing cluster-scoped MRs keep working.

decision.reason: [ev-dd988a5ed5c3] is step 4 of the Crossplane v2 upgrade guide's "Upgrade approach": operators should update their Provider manifests to use v2 provider versions. That makes it an operator step, so the migration family with change type migration-required fits. The name "upgrade-providers-to-v2" is short kebab-case built from the guide's own words ("Upgrade providers", "v2 versions"). This decision covers only subject and change. The same text says existing cluster-scoped MRs keep working unchanged, so whether skipping the step causes anything to fail belongs to the consequence aspect, which is not judged here.
